## Directory

### Coding & Vibe Coding
- [Cursor](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/cursor.html): AI-first code editor with agent mode, codebase chat and tab completion. Pricing: Paid plans from $8/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Bolt.new](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/bolt-new.html): Prompt, run, edit and deploy full-stack web apps right in your browser.
- [v0](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/v0.html): Vercel's AI app builder that turns prompts into React/Next.js apps and UI. Pricing: Plus from $30/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Lovable](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/lovable.html): Build full-stack web apps by chatting with an AI engineer. Free tier: yes.
- [Replit](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/replit.html): Browser IDE with Replit Agent that builds and deploys apps from a prompt. Pricing: Core from $20/mo ($18/mo billed annually). Free tier: yes.
- [GitHub Copilot](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/github-copilot.html): AI pair programmer and coding agent inside VS Code, JetBrains and GitHub. Pricing: Pro from $10/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Devin](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/devin.html): Cognition's coding agents: Devin Desktop (the editor formerly called Windsurf) plus Devin cloud agents. Pricing: Pro from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Zed](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/zed.html): Fast open-source code editor with AI edit predictions, an agent panel and bring-your-own-key support. Pricing: Pro from $10/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [OpenRouter](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/openrouter.html): One OpenAI-compatible API for 500+ models from 80+ providers, with fallback routing. Pricing: Pay-as-you-go; 5.5% fee on credit purchases. Free tier: yes.
- [Hugging Face](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/hugging-face.html): The hub for open models, datasets and Spaces demos, plus hosted inference. Pricing: PRO from $9/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Claude Code](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/claude-code.html): Anthropic's agentic coding tool for the terminal, IDE and web. Pricing: Included with paid Claude plans.
- [OpenAI Codex](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/openai-codex.html): OpenAI's coding agent for the CLI, IDE and cloud tasks.
- [Warp](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/warp.html): Agentic terminal and development environment with built-in AI agents. Pricing: Build from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Cline](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/cline.html): Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code. Pricing: Open source.
- [Aider](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/aider.html): Open-source AI pair programming in your terminal, with git integration. Pricing: Open source.

### Chat Assistants
- [ChatGPT](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/chatgpt.html): OpenAI's general-purpose AI assistant for chat, writing, code and images. Free tier: yes.
- [Claude](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/claude.html): Anthropic's AI assistant for writing, analysis and coding. Pricing: Pro from $17/mo billed annually ($20 monthly). Free tier: yes.
- [Gemini](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/gemini.html): Google's AI assistant, connected to Google apps and search. Pricing: Google AI Plus from $4.99/mo (US). Free tier: yes.
- [Grok](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/grok.html): xAI's AI assistant with real-time knowledge from X and the web.
- [Microsoft Copilot](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/microsoft-copilot.html): Microsoft's AI companion for chat, search and creation.
- [Le Chat (Mistral)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/le-chat-mistral.html): Mistral AI's chat assistant.
- [Ollama](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/ollama.html): Run open models locally with one command, or use Ollama's cloud models when your machine isn't enough. Pricing: Paid plans from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [LM Studio](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/lm-studio.html): Desktop app (now with the Bionic agent) for downloading and running local LLMs via llama.cpp and MLX. Pricing: Bionic+ from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [DeepSeek](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/deepseek.html): Chat assistant powered by DeepSeek's open-weight models.

### AI for IT & Cybersecurity
- [TryHackMe (Echo)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/tryhackme-echo.html): Hands-on cyber training labs with Echo, a built-in AI tutor that gives context-aware hints without handing you the answer.
- [HTB Academy (HTB Coach)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/htb-academy-htb-coach.html): Hack The Box's training modules with HTB Coach (beta): AI explanations, section summaries and quizzes tied to what you're studying.
- [PentestGPT](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/pentestgpt.html): Open-source autonomous pentesting agent from USENIX Security 2024 research, with staged recon-to-exploit runs for CTFs and lab targets. Pricing: Open source (MIT).
- [Burp AI (PortSwigger)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/burp-ai-portswigger.html): AI pentesting partner built into Repeater in Burp Suite Professional for validating findings and cutting scan noise.
- [Microsoft Security Copilot](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/microsoft-security-copilot.html): Generative AI for security teams across Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Entra, Intune and Purview: summarize incidents, write queries and reverse-engineer malicious scripts in plain English. Pricing: Pay-as-you-go: $4 per provisioned SCU/hour.
- [Google Security Operations](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/google-security-operations.html): Google's SecOps platform (SIEM + SOAR) with Gemini for natural-language search, detection writing and investigation.
- [CrowdStrike Charlotte AI](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/crowdstrike-charlotte-ai.html): Agentic security analyst in the CrowdStrike platform that triages detections and speeds up investigations.
- [Splunk AI Assistant](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/splunk-ai-assistant.html): Natural-language assistant in Splunk for finding dashboards, reports and data and getting help with searches over your logs.
- [Elastic Security AI](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/elastic-security-ai.html): AI in Elastic Security: automated alert triage and hypothesis-driven threat hunts with ES|QL over your SIEM data.
